content: Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process he does not become a monster.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
story: Witnessing the rising tides of ideological fanaticism, nationalism, and vengefulness across 19th-century Europe, Nietzsche warned against moral self-righteousness. When people embark on crusades against perceived evil, they frequently adopt the very brutality, deceit, and cruelty of the adversary they set out to defeat. The hunter becomes the prey of the very darkness he fights.
reflectionPrompt: In defending your values or opposing things you dislike, are you maintaining your compassion and integrity, or adopting the harsh tactics of your adversaries?
